headline: A simulation-trained robot agent reports transfer to new real tasks and a second embodiment
summary: A Luma-affiliated arXiv preprint introduces ZAP, which starts from a 27B vision-language model and teaches robot motion through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning entirely in simulation. The authors report 96.7% success over 30 real-robot trials across 10 tasks, matching GPT-6 Astra in their harness, with lower average time and cost; the same checkpoint also reports transfer from a bimanual robot to a single-arm Franka. These results are author-reported measurements from a bounded evaluation and have not been independently reproduced.
